description: Apply entries of config/sync to the database with the plugin's own import — a role's permissions, a content-manager view, a setting. `keys` is required: never everything at once. An entry only in the database is deleted from it. Afterwards, the entries still different are exported back (`reexport`, default true): the database's own form of what was just imported (a generated documentId…), so the diff converges. Refused with NODE_ENV=production. It runs the project's code: Strapi is loaded the way config-sync's own CLI does (no server, no port, no admin account), and a load does what a start of `strapi develop` does to the database (schema sync, pending migrations) — so only on a local development database: a remote one, a Strapi 4 database under Strapi 5 code, or a missing SQLite file are refused before Strapi's bootstrap (where it writes to the database).

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

reexport.description: Export back the entries still different afterwards (default true).

name: config_sync_import
title: config-sync: import entries from config/sync into the database
